calculation.expression: -(close / close.shift(3) - 1) * log1p(max(volume / rolling_mean(volume,20) - 1, 0)) using volume and price through t-1
calculation.description: Fades the prior three-session return, with magnitude amplified by an unusually high latest completed-session volume relative to its 20-session mean. The volume surprise is lagged one session to prevent using the decision-day bar.

validation.regime_notes: Passes benchmark daily IC and ICIR gates, but evidence is limited to 107 dates and average 9 instruments because volume is sparse across the synthetic cross-asset universe. Interpret conservatively and require rolling revalidation.
